main.description: ISIC Rev.4 4-digit class definition. AT Protocol record carrying the canonical taxonomy entry — `code` is the 4-digit class, `section` (1 letter A–U) / `division` (2 digits) / `group` (3 digits) materialize the hierarchy as MST-traversal prefixes. Seeded once per ISIC revision (~10 year cadence) from `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-open-isic/data/classes/{code}.json`. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: replaces the legacy `vertex_open_isic_class` RW table with an MST + IPFS-anchored record set. Substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) provides the trust-less verification path for the taxonomy itself.

code.description: ISIC Rev.4 4-digit class code (e.g. '0111', '2520'). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

nameEn.description: Canonical English name of the class.

section.description: ISIC section, 1 letter A–U (derived from division).

description.description: Free-text description as published by the UN ISIC Rev.4 source.

includes.description: Inclusions list — activities explicitly covered by this class.

excludes.description: Exclusions list — activities deliberately routed to other classes.

handbookCid.description: Optional CID of the published ISIC Rev.4 handbook chapter PDF, when blob-attached via `e.write({blobs: {handbook: pdfBlob}})`.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this class entry was published in the ISIC revision. Defaults to the per-class implementedAt in the source data.
